name: io.visamundi/visa
title: Visamundi — Visa & Travel Requirements
description: Visa, vaccine and customs requirements for 190+ destinations, plus visa application filing.

tools.name: list_visas
tools.description: Discover visa products available for a destination. Use after you know the destination country; optionally narrow results by traveller nationality, trip reason, minimum stay length, or response language. Prefer this before get_visa when the user has not chosen a product yet.

destination.description: Destination country ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code (for example TH or IND).

nationality.description: Optional traveller nationality ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code.

reason.description: Optional travel reason slug such as tourism or business.

stay_duration.description: Optional minimum stay duration in days.

language.description: Optional ISO 639-1 language code for localized fields.

tools.name: get_visa
tools.description: Fetch full details for one visa product by numeric ID. Use after list_visas when the user selected a product or when you already have the product ID.

language.description: Optional ISO 639-1 language code for localized fields.

tools.name: get_visa_requirements
tools.description: Check whether a visa is required and what rule applies for a traveller nationality visiting a destination. Use this first for questions like 'Do I need a visa?' before listing or comparing products.

nationality.description: Traveller nationality ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code.

destination.description: Destination country ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code.

language.description: Optional ISO 639-1 language code for localized fields.

tools.name: get_vaccines
tools.description: Return vaccination guidance for a destination country. Use for health-entry questions after you know the destination ISO code.

country_code.description: Destination country ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code.

tools.name: get_customs
tools.description: Return customs and import rules for a destination country. Use for baggage, restricted goods, and entry-declaration questions.

country_code.description: Destination country ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code.

tools.name: get_application_form
tools.description: Get everything needed to fill a Visamundi visa application for one visa product: accepted purposes and nationalities, the JSON Schema of `values` and `travelers`, the visa questionnaire, date and passport-validity constraints, arrival-card and insurance options, and the estimated price. Call after get_visa, before save_application.

visaId.description: Visa product ID, as returned by list_visas / get_visa.

language.description: Language of labels and questions (default en).

tools.name: save_application
tools.description: Create (without applicationId) or update (with applicationId + resumeToken) a Visamundi visa application for the traveller. Returns applicationId, resumeToken, reference, the price and `missing`: the exact fields still required. Repeat until `missing` is empty, then call get_payment_link. Only use information given by the traveller. Consents and payment are always done by the traveller on the payment page.

visaId.description: Visa product ID, as returned by list_visas / get_visa.

locale.description: Language of the traveller: used for emails and the payment page.

applicationId.description: applicationId returned by the first save_application call.

resumeToken.description: resumeToken returned by the first save_application call. Keep it private.

values.description: Application-level answers (contact, trip dates, purpose, billing address, questionnaire, options), keyed as in the `values` schema of get_application_form.

travelers.description: One object per traveller (identity and passport), keyed as in the `travelers` schema of get_application_form. On update, travellers are merged by position.

affiliateCode.description: Visamundi partner code (e.g. ag404), only if the traveller came through a partner link (`?partner=` / `?agence=`). Never guess one. Ignored if the application already has one.

tools.name: get_payment_link
tools.description: Get the Visamundi payment link for a complete application. Give this link to the traveller: they review the application, accept the terms and pay there. Also returns `estimatedDelivery` (null when unavailable): `latestDate` (YYYY-MM-DD) is an estimate, never a guarantee; always state it together with `condition`, and with `cappedExplanation` when `cappedFarTrip` is true (issuance deliberately scheduled closer to a distant trip). Fails with the list of missing fields if the application is incomplete.

applicationId.description: applicationId returned by the first save_application call.

resumeToken.description: resumeToken returned by the first save_application call. Keep it private.
